fixes.problem: Long prose measures recur in hercule-whitehaven-thread-long-1x.png (522, 226, 714, 133) and hercule-whitehaven-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 319, 623, 38).
fixes.change: Set prose max-inline-size to 64ch and line-height to 22px. Measure rendered paragraphs against the 60–75-character target.

fixes.problem: Supporting details are weak in hercule-whitehaven-thread-long-1x.png (495, 865, 722, 15), hercule-whitehaven-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 396, 623, 15), and hercule-whitehaven-workflows-1x.png (1294, 139, 120, 746).
fixes.change: Use secondary text ink oklch(0.52 0.012 80) at opacity 1 for timestamps, work summaries, workspace labels and state suffixes. Preserve colleague name hues. Verify at least 4.5:1 text contrast against each actual surface.

fixes.problem: Small metadata repeats in hercule-whitehaven-thread-long-1x.png (522, 89, 226, 54), hercule-whitehaven-tracking-pane-1x.png (781, 396, 623, 15), and hercule-whitehaven-workflows-1x.png (570, 139, 844, 259).
fixes.change: Use font-size 12px, line-height 16px and font-weight 400 as the minimum metadata role for work summaries, source details, percentages and times.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-workflows-1x.png (748, 267, 219, 131): history checks and crosses are too small to distinguish reliably by shape at 1x.
fixes.change: Render history marks at 12×12px with 2px strokes. Arrange 20 marks in two rows of ten with 4px horizontal and vertical gaps, filling left-to-right with the older row first. The group occupies 156×28px within a 40px row.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-workflows-1x.png (589, 265, 151, 620): Starts on repeatedly exposes raw event keys rather than plain event names.
fixes.change: Display github.issue.opened as 'GitHub issue opened', github.issue.labeled as 'GitHub issue labeled', github.issue.assigned as 'GitHub issue assigned', github.pr.opened as 'GitHub pull request opened', github.pr.merged as 'GitHub pull request merged', github.issue.closed as 'GitHub issue closed', and run.failed as 'Run failed'. Allow two lines at 12px/16px within the 40px row.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-tracking-pane-1x.png (282, 341, 412, 69): green marks, row tint and the finished subtitle assign green to completion alongside the mint colleague identity.
fixes.change: Set the finished row background to transparent. Render the Finished heading, completion mark and word finished in existing primary text ink at opacity 1. Preserve mint on the colleague face and Review PR name. Character cost: less coloured surface area around that colleague.

fixes.problem: hercule-whitehaven-wiki-1x.png (1128, 272, 110, 16): 'run 4f2a91c0' exposes an identifier without identifying the workflow responsible for the change.
fixes.change: Use the owning workflow's display name followed by ' · run' as the primary provenance label. Put 'Run 4f2a91c0' on a secondary line at 12px font-size and 16px line-height.

summary: The Hercule captures are coherent, with recurring wide prose, small metadata and tiny workflow history marks. The Ocean reference has clear layer steps but faint code comments. The calibration captures contain saturated fills and nested boxes that may be capture overlays.
